responsibility: Implements the gcov reporting program that reads gcno/gcda coverage data, reconstructs per-function CFGs and line mappings, solves and validates block/arc execution counts, and emits annotated source coverage reports and related summaries. It owns gcov’s in-memory models for functions, blocks, arcs, and lines, handles branch and call coverage presentation, and uses gcov-io plus source-file reading to turn raw profile data into human-readable per-line execution and branch-probability output.
